title: K-2 Sparse High-Power Divisor Sums for All Bounded-Omega Integers
description: Self-contained proof, source-location note, deterministic checker, fixed replay output, and byte manifest for a divisor-sum-oracle factoring theorem. For each fixed K >= 3, K-2 predetermined exact high-power divisor sums suffice for deterministic poly_K(log n) recovery when omega(n) <= K, with arbitrary prime multiplicities. This does not claim an ordinary polynomial-time algorithm without the oracle or query optimality.
